title: coquillage
tagline: ETH Defi Build on Yearn protocol. A simple UI for Yearn Finance.
description:
This is the short version of the vetting process for a new strategy - Yearn landing, and borrowing finance protocol support ETHEREUM, FANTOM, and ARBITRUM network. With a customized stablecoins-only vaults website.
Using the open-source repository: https://github.com/Bild96/coquillage.eth
how_its_made:
Using  Yearn Finance SDK Docs.
This is a simple UI version of the vetting process for a new strategy.

Code the strategy using brownie-strategy-mix repository
Complete peer review by, at least, 2 other strategists
Test in prod on ape.tax with real funds
Create a Due Diligence document for the protocol. Follow the example: SNX
Get the strategy approved by the Safe Farming Committee
Complete review by one internal auditor (includes internal risk score)
The strategy goes to prod

When the strategy has more than 3M-10M in TVL, it should improve it's risk score.

Risk-score dimension: 1=best, 5=worst.
